title: Tokyo Bay Port Terminal Wind Advisory & Crane Operation Thresholds
snippet: Container terminals in Tokyo and Yokohama ports typically suspend gantry crane operations when gust wind speeds exceed 15.0 to 20.0 m/s.

title: 2026 Maritime ETA Forecasting Public Leaderboard & Open Benchmarks
snippet: Public maritime ETA forecasting models incorporating berth congestion features report nDCG@10 scores between 0.87 and 0.89 on standard port datasets.
